personal.title: CS student at University of Manitoba
personal.summary: Computer Science Honours student at the University of Manitoba with extensive full-stack co-op experience. Proven track record of independently shipping critical production tools, managing full software development lifecycles, and engineering high-performance backend systems.

education.degree: Bachelor of Computer Science Honours (Co-op Option)

experience.description: Full-stack development in an Agile environment delivering mission-critical web applications.
bullets: Independently migrated a large, actively developed production application from Vue 2 to Vue 3 in 1.5 months, shipping ahead of schedule with strong mentor recognition for speed and quality.
Built 7+ React administrative screens; initiated technical design discussions with a senior developer that led to a revised componentization standard adopted project-wide.
Engineered a reusable Notification System using React Context for deployment across the company's suite of React applications.
Established the team’s first automated frontend test suite by integrating Vitest into a legacy Vue 2 environment and wrote component tests as practical templates for future developers.

experience.company: Public Guardian and Trustee of Manitoba
experience.description: Managed the full software development lifecycle for internal windows tools and collaborated on core enterprise system modernizations.
bullets: Independently built a .NET/WinForms client search tool over 2 months, taking full ownership of the entire SDLC and implementing fuzzy search with a local asynchronous cache handling 100,000+ records to significantly optimize mailroom workflows.

Collaborated closely with a senior developer on a legacy modernization of the company's core trustee management system, participating in client design meetings and proposing UI mockups adopted into production.
Evaluated system architecture and proposed database normalization improvements during structural design reviews that were successfully adopted into production.
Automated and optimized internal accounting workflows using Laserfiche integrated with JavaScript and CSS.
Implemented VBA processes for automated data updates and imports to ensure database integrity.

projects.name: CO-APP (Software Engineering Group Project)
projects.description: Engineered a Job Application REST API and filtering backend across two Agile sprints, implementing paginated results, multi-status filtering, keyword search, and interview date-range queries.
bullets: Authored all cross-feature integration tests for the team alongside full unit test coverage, achieving near-complete line and branch coverage validated via Codecov in CI.

Configured the Render hosting environment and designed a k6 load test across 14 endpoints and 20 concurrent users, achieving a 100% check pass rate and exceeding the target throughput by 747% (1,694 req/min).

projects.name: CSSA Game Jam 2025: Crabby Game
projects.description: Won Audience Choice and Highest Potential awards (highest critic ratings for game quality and mechanics) out of the entire competition framework.
bullets: Created and led a 4-person development team, directing scope adjustments and assigning work to keep the project shippable within a strict 48-hour deadline.
Implemented player movement mechanics, a modular character controller, the combat system (hitboxes, damage, knockback), and round-based evolution logic with no prior experience in the engine.
